base: Top-down photo, phone held directly above, of a small white USB desk fan (about 20 cm, no brand) lying face-up on a green self-healing cutting mat with faint grid lines. Visible from above: a round white wire front grille held by a thin grey plastic clip ring, behind it four translucent light-blue fan blades with a small round orange spinner cap in the center. The fan's white base stand sticks out to the right. Two small silver Phillips screws sit in the base stand. Plenty of empty mat around the object.
